units.source_text: [\[13\]](#part1335.html#w13) 白居易《秦中吟》中《重赋》一篇中说：“

en.t: In Bai Juyi's Qin Zhong Yin, the poem Heavy Taxes says: "

units.source_text: 夜深烟火尽，霰雪白纷纷。

en.t: Late at night, the smoke and fires are gone, and sleet and snow fall thick and white.

units.source_text: 幼者形不蔽，老者体无温。

en.t: The young have nothing to cover their bodies, and the old have no warmth in their limbs.

units.source_text: 悲端与寒气，并入鼻中辛。”

en.t: Sorrow and cold air together enter the nose, stinging bitterly."
